value: REFINES claim.law.PL_cell4-region-boundary-is-a-call-not-a-syntactic-block.20260901.v1: ITS CALL-IN-LIVE-SPAN SCREEN IS NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT, AND A SITE THAT PASSES IT CAN STILL LOSE. The parent law's free textual screen is genuinely useful and is not being overturned - it correctly and cheaply rejected the `speaker = PT(k)` base in do_players, and it retro-explains kill_player and abort_player. What is new is the measurement of the sites it ACCEPTS. All six do_players sites this screen qualifies (three single-read `state` sites, two `speech_req` sites, one `fn_8009D610(0, PT(i)->col_pos)` site - each a base formed and consumed by ONE memory operand with no call anywhere in its live span, which is as cleanly qualifying as the screen can get) were converted to the cell-4 PTA form and MEASURED: real 1024 -> 1057 with fresh fuzzy exactly FLAT at 93.7436%. A four-site subset dropping the two sites confounded by a comparison-chain diff still measured real 1045, i.e. still +21 over baseline, on fuzzy 93.7777%. So the qualifying set lost in both forms. WHAT THE SUBSET SPLIT ADDS, and it is the part worth carrying forward: the four-site and six-site `--ops` target-only/ours-only columns are BYTE-IDENTICAL. The two extra sites therefore bought ZERO structural convergence and cost +12 real by themselves, while the four 'clean' sites bought exactly ONE opcode token (a single lwzx -> lwz) for +21 real. A conversion whose entire structural yield is one token is not paying for the address-web disturbance it causes elsewhere in a 1174-instruction function, regardless of how well each individual site scores on the region screen. PRACTICAL RULE: treat the call-in-live-span screen as a cheap NECESSARY filter that tells you which sites are worth measuring, never as a prediction that the conversion will win, and always census the expected structural yield first - count how many indexed loads (lwzx) the conversion could plausibly turn into displacement loads (lwz), and if that count is one or two on a large function, do not spend the build. write_health_and_items remains the only measured win of this form in this TU, and its two sites feed ONE local consumed in straight-line code, which is a materially stronger condition than 'each site individually has no call in its span'. SECOND, INDEPENDENT FINDING from the same aligned view, recorded here because it constrains any future attempt at these sites: at @0x24c and @0x6c4 the target loads the SAME ADDRESS TWICE through two different base forms (`lwz r0,232(r18)` with r18 = r31+3136, then `add r3,r31,r16` / `lwz r0,3368(r3)`, and 3136+232 == 3368), where we emit one load and reuse it. Deleting the `st` temporary and re-reading `PT(j)->state` three times to try to reproduce that duplication is a NULL EDIT: it measured NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL with the object bytes unchanged, because MWCC CSEs textually identical member expressions straight back to a single load. The target's two-load shape is therefore not reachable by repeating one spelling and must come from two DIFFERENT spellings of the same address, which is where the next probe on this cluster belongs.
